note: Hyperion product catalog. Products with source 'brochure' are fully detailed from real brochures (source of truth). Products with source 'prd' are described from the PRD and should get a brochure before heavy pitching.

products.name: Warehouse Management (WMS)
products.solves: Paper GRN, no bin strategy, high mispick, silent damages, untrustworthy book stock
products.how: Scanner-first GRN with live variance, ABC zoning + guided putaway, wave/batch/zone picks (mispick <0.2%), photo-logged damages, daily cycle counts (>99% accuracy), dock SLA, cold-chain alerts, offline-capable Android app

products.name: Inventory Management (IMS)
products.solves: Four systems with four stock numbers, marketplace oversell, expiries found at audit, fudged landed cost/COGS, gut-feel reorder
products.how: One authoritative multi-node ledger, real-time reservations (zero oversell), expiry alerts 90 days out, batch-accurate landed cost/COGS/margin, auto-draft POs from ROP & vendor score, reconciliation & audit trail

products.name: Order & Delivery Management
products.solves: One-size delivery, slots without capacity checks, quick-commerce on spreadsheets, returns without QC
products.how: Four delivery modes per category/pincode (On-demand, Slot, Quick-com, Try & Buy), capacity-aware slot engine, rider app (OTP/photo-POD/COD), return QC, COD recon & settlement, courier orchestration & OMS sync

products.name: Fleet Management & MIS
products.solves: Docs/challans on WhatsApp, paper attendance/earnings, late MIS, no cost-per-km view
products.how: One ledger for every vehicle/driver/ticket, ticket->quotation->work->close, auto-settled earnings, live MIS with photo-backed QC, utilisation/cost-per-km/SLA in real time

products.name: Rental Management for Fleets
products.solves: Off-platform deposits, scattered handover photos, verbal KYC, no asset hand-pass history
products.how: Razorpay-backed deposit ledger with auto-debits, photo-backed handover & return QC, KYC + Aadhaar e-sign vault, configurable plans, full hand-pass history, damage debits with evidence

products.name: Manufacturing Operations
products.solves: Raw-material planning gaps, vendor purchase delays, manual production planning, QC approval delays, batch tracking issues, finished-goods gaps
products.how: Connects raw-material planning, vendor POs, production planning, QC approvals, batch tracking and finished-goods inventory into one execution layer

products.name: Central Kitchen Operations
products.solves: Daily production planning, recipe/BOM management, hub allocation, batch movement, wastage, expiry, hub replenishment, transfer planning, dispatch control
products.how: Connects recipe/BOM, daily production planning, hub-wise allocation, batch & expiry tracking, transfer planning and dispatch into one operating layer

products.name: Store Fulfillment
products.solves: Multi-channel order visibility, ship-from-store, retail stock allocation
products.how: Routes orders across stores and warehouses, ship-from-store, allocation and fulfilment visibility

products.name: Workflow Automation
products.solves: Manual approvals, exceptions discovered late, routine ops work done by hand
products.how: Always-on rules and automations across operations: alerts, escalations, approval routing, exception handling

products.name: Compliance Management
products.solves: Compliance documentation done by hand, audit trails missing
products.how: Digitises compliance documentation, audit trails and approvals

products.name: Control Tower
products.solves: Fragmented operational visibility; reports exist but action items are manual
products.how: A single operations command view across inventory, warehouse, delivery and fleet — live KPIs, exceptions and SLAs

products.name: ERP Integration Layer
products.solves: ERP stores transactions but does not automate daily execution; teams still use Excel, WhatsApp and calls
products.how: Sits on top of SAP/Oracle/Tally/Busy/Zoho/Ginesys/custom ERP as an AI-native execution layer — automates execution, reporting, approvals, exceptions and follow-ups without replacing the ERP

products.name: AI Agent Layer
products.solves: Repetitive operational work that waits on humans
products.how: A layer of AI agents that watch operations and act — replenishment, QC follow-up, dispatch exceptions, daily MIS, approval routing and more
